lead: Smita Patil was an Indian film actor, born on 17 October 1955 in Pune.
She died on 13 December 1986 in Mumbai at the age of 31.
She is associated with work such as Manthan, Bhumika and Aakrosh and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Filmfare Award for Best Actress.
Below you will find a verified overview of Smita Patil: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Smita Patil — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Smita Patil was born on 17 October 1955 in Pune, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Shivajirao Girdhar Patil.
Her listed education includes St. Xavier's College, University of Mumbai, Elphinstone College and Fergusson College.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi and Marathi.

sections.heading: Smita Patil — Career and Professional Work
paras: Smita Patil works primarily as a film actor, stage actor, television actor and news presenter.
Among the credits most often linked to Smita are Manthan, Bhumika, Aakrosh, Chakra, Chidambaram, Mirch Masala and Waaris.
